back: An amount posted to the wrong class of account (e.g. an asset as an expense). The trial balance still agrees.

front: Correcting profit when an asset was expensed
back: Draft profit + cost wrongly expensed − depreciation that should have been charged.

front: Is working capital affected by misclassifying expenditure?
back: Usually not: the bank or payable entry was correct; only the debit is wrong. It changes only if a current item (e.g. inventory) is involved.
Shown higher than the correct figure.

front: Effect on next year of expensing an asset
back: No depreciation is charged later, so future profits are overstated and comparisons are distorted.
